source_primary.title: Primordial Orbital Alignment of Sednoids
source_primary.note: Values below are the barycentric orbital elements reported in Table 1, sourced by the authors from JPL SBDB.

source_interpretation.authors_conclusion: If confirmed by future sednoids, the primordial alignment is more naturally evidence for an early event and is incompatible with a still-present distant planet as its cause.
